label: The Cuban and Mexican flags merging over the water
description: Two transparent flags moving over the water, Cuba above and Mexico below, trying to merge together in some way, seen alongside the Secretary of State in the office dealing with the Spanish-speaking, Mexican and Cuban peoples, and a lizard whispering in the president's ear with his full attention. What a merger would mean is never said, which is what keeps it from being scoreable.
aliases: Cuba was on top, the Mexican flag was on bottom
they were trying to merge together in some way
they were transparent and they were moving upon the water

label: Transparent spider drones, a new AI weapon out of Israel
description: Spiders seen over Israel alongside blessing on its agriculture, which the Lord tells him are drones, a new tech boom using AI as a weapon, transparent with moving bellies. He breaks off saying he may be saying too much and that he thought he was to be still, so the description stops there. A deployed drone of that form would be recognisable.
aliases: Lord said that what you're seeing is drones
I see spiders that are transparent

label: A named justice swayed on the tariff case by foreign and financial pressure
description: A black alligator with black onyx eyes and a purple energy outline, identified as a named Supreme Court justice who must be prayed for and swayed because she is the problem on the tariff ruling, with the pressure traced to a named asset manager influencing the judges and to Canada and its prime minister over funding, the Democratic Party, the euro and a Canadian recession turning to depression. The ruling itself is a matter of record, and the influence claim is what would have to be shown.
aliases: it's Amy Comey Barrett is the one that we got to sway
This has to do with BlackRock influencing the judges
It's more about Canada and the economy going into a great recession

label: A new sexually transmitted disease with welts and pus over the face
description: A new venereal disease never seen before, coming through practices he calls ungodly, so grotesque that it brings welts and pus over the face, starting in the north east which he thinks is Minnesota, spreading into Toronto and throughout New York and Boston and the major cities, and getting much worse. He points to reported cases with facial infection as the fulfilment while saying he does not know whether it is the same thing.
aliases: a new venerial disease that had never been seen before
it would bring welps and and pus all over your
the Lord said it will start up northeast
